digest.component_or_area: Backend Protocol & Reconciler Vendor Adapter Seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) contain nested lazy imports of adapters.jira that must be eliminated to satisfy epic bbf1 AC3 zero-import constraint.

Backend Protocol must be extended with scalar, vendor-neutral read-only members: project (DIG-defaulted for applier guard), query_project (un-defaulted fail-closed for fetcher), and assert_env_ready() (JIRA_* env validation).

BackendEnvError and BackendAssigneeNotFoundError neutral exceptions must be defined in _backend.py; JiraBackend.assert_env_ready() raises BackendEnvError for missing JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN; JiraBackend.AssigneeNotFoundError subclasses the neutral base.
All four modules must route through backend instance or registry seam (select_backend), eliminating every adapters.jira and acli_subprocess import at any nesting depth.
Full-tree AST walker using ast.walk (not top-level-only) must gate that fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, and _attestation contain zero adapters.jira imports at any depth.
S2 contract suite and FakeBackend must be updated to satisfy the widened Backend Protocol; behavior must remain identical (DIG default, fail-closed scoping, env fail-fast, soft-fail assignee errors).
